prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case, how serious your injuries are, and what kind of lawyer you prefer (trial-focused, high-value settlements, boutique vs. large firm). I can help you find good options, but here are practical steps and resources so you can pick the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for your situation.

How to choose
- Look for experience with Houston car-accident cases and significant verdicts/settlements for injuries like yours.
- Trial experience (if your case might go to court).
- Licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of Texas.
- Contingency-fee arrangement (most PI lawyers charge only if you recover).
- Clear communication, transparency about fees and expenses, and a designated point of contact.
- Read client reviews and verify results (not just marketing claims).

Questions to ask during a free consult
- How many car-crash cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine (e.g., back injuries, traumatic brain injury)?
- What results have you obtained for similar cases?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee and how are costs handled?
- What is a realistic estimate of value and timeline?

Where to search and verify credentials
- State Bar of Texas attorney lookup (discipline and license status).
- Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo — for ratings and peer reviews.
- Texas Trial Lawyers Association (now Texas Trial Lawyers) or local Houston trial lawyer groups.
- Google reviews and Better Business Bureau for client feedback.

Practical tips
- Act quickly: Texas generally has a two-year statute of limitations for personal injury claims (so don’t wait).
- Preserve evidence: photos, medical records, police report, witness contact info.
- Contact 3–5 attorneys for free consultations and compare.

If you want, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston,
- A brief summary of the crash (date, injuries, insurance issues),
and I’ll find several well-reviewed Houston personal injury attorneys who fit your needs and list contact info and why they might be a good match.
